integrations.name: OS MCP Registry
integrations.notes: Local discovery adapter; mark verified only after a successful MCP client tools/list call.

integrations.name: OS Workspace Core
integrations.notes: Separate service; registry must not claim that Workspace Core is deployed.

integrations.name: GitHub
integrations.notes: Connector access depends on individual client/app authorization; no OS-wide token is assumed.

integrations.name: Google Drive
integrations.notes: Canonical cloud documents when user has verified permissions; no automatic synchronization.

integrations.name: Box
integrations.notes: Verify connector availability and ownership per client.

integrations.name: Notion
integrations.notes: Native connector is not automatically a public MCP endpoint.

integrations.name: Obsidian Vault
integrations.notes: Explicit allowlisted vault path required prior to enablement.

integrations.name: n8n Workflows
integrations.notes: Existing service is not automatically an MCP server; verify remote routing and auth.

integrations.name: Ollama Inference
integrations.notes: Endpoint is host-local on HPC in past observations, not reachable from Spectre without separate connection.

integrations.name: Open WebUI
integrations.notes: Do not mistake web UI for MCP; verify before adding a bridge.

integrations.name: Docker MCP Gateway
integrations.notes: Optional next phase; do not mount Docker socket into an exposed MCP process by default.

integrations.name: Home Assistant
integrations.notes: Never enable actuator controls without explicit scope and confirmations.

integrations.name: Figma
integrations.notes: Editable native artifacts remain authoritative in Figma.

integrations.name: Adobe
integrations.notes: Native source of truth for editable Adobe assets.

integrations.name: Cloudflare
integrations.notes: Do not attach the shivanshsethi.in zone or mutate DNS without verification.

integrations.name: Credential Broker
integrations.notes: Store references only, never vault contents or token values.

collections.name: Knowledge and Research

collections.name: Creative Studio

collections.name: Systems, Domain, Security
